# gamma fixtures

Copied unchanged from the gamma repository (github.com/su3co/gamma, MIT
licence, commit f15caec): `examples/mmi-splitter/build/mmi.gds`,
`mmi.ports.json` and `stack.toml` (the same stack as `tests/fixtures/wire`),
and `tests/fixtures/wire/build/wire.gds` and `wire.ports.json`. The tests
check that lightsim reads gamma's port and layer-stack files as they are.
